data.name: Diego De Almagro Valdivia Hotel
data.address: Av. Arturo Prat 433, Valdivia, Los Ríos, Chile
data.description:
Overlooking the River Calle-Calle, this unpretentious hotel is 1 km from the Museo Naval Submarino O' Brien and 2 km from the Jardín Botánico UACh.
Straightforward rooms feature Wi-Fi, flat-screens and minifridges, plus safes. Upgraded rooms add river views. Room service is available.
There's a restaurant and an indoor pool as well as a bar, a business center and meeting space. A breakfast buffet and parking are available.
